command:
set -euo pipefail
make check-agent-config
bash skills/scripts/check-review-checklist-staleness.sh
bash skills/scripts/finish-check-greps.sh
bash skills/scripts/check-orphan-fixtures.sh

set -euo pipefail
for test_script in deploy/test/test-*.sh; do bash "$test_script"; done

set -euo pipefail
for suite in ../plugins/easy/backend/tests ../plugins/notice/backend/tests ../plugins/invoice/backend/tests ../plugins/cloud-deploy/backend/tests; do
  docker compose exec -T -e DB_DATABASE=ssl_manager_test app php artisan test "$suite"
done

set -euo pipefail
for archive in build/temp/packages/ssl-manager-{full,upgrade,script}-0.0.0-finish-check.zip; do
  test -s "$archive"
  unzip -tq "$archive"
done
if unzip -l build/temp/packages/ssl-manager-full-0.0.0-finish-check.zip | grep -Eq 'backend/storage/app/'; then exit 1; fi
echo PACKAGE_INVARIANTS_PASS

set -euo pipefail
git diff --check
bash -n backend/scripts/test-mutate.sh build/release.sh plugins/release-plugin.sh skills/scripts/check-review-checklist-staleness.sh skills/scripts/derive-scope.sh skills/scripts/run-isolated-mutation.sh
shfmt -d -i 4 -ci backend/scripts/test-mutate.sh build/release.sh plugins/release-plugin.sh skills/scripts/check-review-checklist-staleness.sh skills/scripts/derive-scope.sh skills/scripts/run-isolated-mutation.sh
frontend/admin/node_modules/.bin/prettier --check skills/finish-check.md skills/review-checklist.md skills/backend/core.md skills/ops/build-release.md skills/remote-release.md
PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=/tmp/ssl-manager-finish-check-pycache python3 -m py_compile skills/scripts/finish-check-exec.py skills/scripts/mutation-shards.py skills/scripts/tests/test_derive_scope_mutation.py skills/scripts/tests/test_finish_check_exec.py skills/scripts/tests/test_mutation_shards.py skills/scripts/tests/test_mutate_targets.py skills/scripts/tests/test_release_plugin_isolation.py skills/scripts/tests/test_release_mutation_guard.py
python3 -m json.tool skills/finish-check-gates.json >/dev/null
python3 -m json.tool skills/mutation-shards.json >/dev/null
